description:
Anime adaptation of the Saiki Kusuo no Ψ-nan manga by Asou Shuichi, telling the story about a male high school student named Kasuo Saiki. He possesses supernatural powers that cause unfortunate events in his everyday life.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: This short series was released exclusively through the Jump LIVE (ジャンプLIVE) mobile app.
